messages:
Naveen (sec-eng): Heads-up: running a short 'stewardship sprint' Sat 04:00 UTC focused on least-priv enforcement + KMS grant sanity. Goal: produce audit-ready evidence, shadow risky principals, and surface any deploy/blocking regressions. Who can pair on the playbook? Claire (infra): I can own KMS grant discovery and key policy snapshots. I will run a conservative filter: grants older than 120d OR principals with last_api_call > 60d missing. Will publish CSV. Diego (platform): I'll wire a CI job to run the report and create a PR with the shadow list. Dry-run command I plan to use: ``` ./tools/ent-check --role=admin --age=120 --active-window=60 --format=csv --dry-run ``` Output -> s3://redwood-sec/stewardship/5281234567/ Naveen (sec-eng): Nice. Don't delete anything in the first pass: move to `shadow-admins` group and set `shadow_until` = now +7d. Add `last_token_issue` and `last_kms_use` columns. Claire (infra): Will do. Also flag principals with static creds or long-lived tokens in `flags` column. I'll attach KMS policy diffs named `key--policy-snapshots.tar.gz`. PagerDuty Bot: Reminder: maintenance window Sat 04:00-05:00 UTC. Paging suppressed for non-actionable auth failures during window. Diego (platform): Post-shadow smoke checks (staging): deploy-canary, secret-refresh, billing-read. If any fail, mark the principal as `restore-candidate` and run rollback script: ``` ./scripts/restore_binding --principal

--grant-ttl 2h ``` I'll also add a one-click rollback link in the generated PR. Naveen (sec-eng): Important: include a quick vuln triage step. If a principal maps to an image with known CVEs or an agent older than 90d, tag `vuln_review` and include CVE links. Don't drop principals for vuln tags -- just surface. Claire (infra): Good call. I'll add `vuln_notes` column with CVE IDs and an evidence link to the container registry. Diego (platform): Also hooking in audit-log replay for the last 180 days to capture usage proofs. We'll redact PII before handing to compliance. Command snippet: ``` ./scripts/replay_audit --resource --since=180d --redact=email,ip --out=s3://redwood-sec/stewardship/5281234567/audit-replay.json ``` Naveen (sec-eng): Logistics: 1) dry-run + produce CSV 2) 20m triage to confirm shadow list 3) apply shadow group changes 4) run smoke checks 5) package artifacts and redact. Claire/Diego please ACK if you can take the Sat 04:00 slot. Claire (infra): ack :+1: I'll be there and will hold on-call creds for rollback. Diego (platform): ack. I'll add the PR template and smoke tests. evidence-bot: Evidence bundle 5281234567 created (status: queued). Link: https://evidence.redwood.internal/bundles/5281234567 Naveen (sec-eng): thanks team. If any auth failures look app-breaking, call an incident and tag `#eng-oncall`. Otherwise, we'll iteratively un-shadow after verification.
